summary: 针对评分者来源与有序评分一致性补学。初次 Europe PMC 和 Crossref 请求因 DNS 失败；随后控制端为这两条研究者查询提供了八项检索结果。我阅读了两篇与跨评委设计/评分者效应相关的外科评估文章段落。其一般设计启发是保留对象×评委交叉链接以拆分方差来源，但不直接给出葡萄酒 ordinal agreement 方法。手算例子说明稳定评委偏移与样本差异如何在简化交叉表分开。具体有序一致性系数及假设仍未知。

evidence.title: Large Language Models as Examinees and Graders in Simulated General Surgery Oral Board-Style Cases: A Psychometric Pilot Study
evidence.quote: Generalizability theory decomposes observed score variance into its underlying sources, such as examinee ability, case difficulty, rater stringency, and their interactions
evidence.scope: General psychometric design concept from a surgical oral-exam study; not wine sensory evidence or an ordinal-rating coefficient.

evidence.title: Multimodal Large Language Models Rate Wetlab Suturing Repeatably but Fail to Detect Training-Related Improvement: A Pilot Study With Expert Assessment
evidence.quote: Only one expert rater was available for this pilot. Inter-rater reliability could therefore not be estimated
evidence.scope: Surgical skill assessment; used only for the design implication that one rater cannot estimate inter-rater reliability.

claims: Published source knowledge: UCI describes the target as the median of at least three expert sensory ratings; this does not provide individual ratings.
Learning example: [4,5,6] and [1,5,9] both have median 5, while ranges are 2 and 8. These are illustrative values, not dataset observations.

Interpretation: individual scores without rater/sample links can describe a score distribution but cannot attribute low/high scoring tendencies to particular raters; crossed linked ratings support studying such attribution. This is design reasoning informed by a non-wine psychometric example, not wine-specific validation.

Worked hypothetical: in a crossed score table A=(6,5), B=(8,7), the second rater is +2 for both samples and both raters score B +2 over A. This illustrates separating additive rater offset from sample contrast; it does not test interactions or ordinal-model assumptions and is not observed data.
limitations: The first direct Europe PMC and Crossref attempts failed due to DNS; the controller subsequently fulfilled the same two queries. The returned relevant readings are excerpt-level and concern surgical assessment, not wine sensory measurement.
I cannot define the formal distinction between ordinal agreement and reliability or select/justify a specific coefficient; the accessed excerpts do not establish ordinal-specific assumptions.
The supplied dataset has no individual ratings or assessor identifiers, so actual agreement and assessor effects remain unestimable from it.
next_actions: Retry targeted method-source retrieval when network DNS is available, prioritizing a methodological review/textbook on ordinal inter-rater agreement and reliability.
Continue to keep median prediction, assessor agreement, and latent sensory attribute as separate candidate question branches until the desired estimand and available design are clearer.
learning_change: 原先我认为补逐位评分即可推进评委层与聚合层比较；现在理解到评分记录必须保留评委与样本的对应关系，且评委/样本来源归因和重复性还需要交叉或重复观测。中位数预测、评委分歧与潜在感官属性仍是不同目标。因两个公开检索端点 DNS 失败，我没有学会有序一致性系数或 agreement/reliability 的正式区别，不能据此选统计方法。

memory_notes.title: 聚合感官评分中位数及其信息边界
memory_notes.understanding: UCI Wine Quality 文档称 quality 是至少三位专家评分的中位数。聚合分不保留个体评分完整分布，无法仅从中位数恢复评委分歧；该数据说明没有个体评分及评委标识。
memory_notes.conditions: 这是 UCI 文档对该数据集的说明；不据此推断实际一致性、评分可靠性或因果机制。Cortez et al. 的预测结果在给定材料中仅为 UCI 转述。
memory_notes.example: 学习例子：[4,5,6] 与 [1,5,9] 的中位数都为 5，极差分别为 2 和 8；只看中位数无法知道离散程度。这不是数据集观测。
open_questions: 每个样本的具体评分人数和逐位分数是否可获得？
Unknown：当前不清楚哪些有序评分一致性指标适用，也不清楚其设计假设。
实际专家间分歧大小未知。
memory_notes.revision_reason: Reused the existing key aggregated_sensory_score_median; clarified its continued source-limited scope without changing the prior understanding.

memory_notes.title: 评委评分需保留评委与样本链接以讨论差异来源
memory_notes.understanding: 无身份的逐位评分可显示评分分布，却不能判断评分倾向是否来自特定评委。保留评委×样本对应关系有助于研究评分者倾向与样本差异；要讨论重复性或流程效应，还需相应重复或跨条件设计。
memory_notes.conditions: 这是从交叉观测结构作出的设计逻辑解释，不是本轮检索到的方法文献定理；具体可识别参数取决于实际设计与模型。
memory_notes.example: 如果两个样本各有三条无身份评分，无法辨别低分是否均来自同一严厉评委；若分数记录带评委ID和样本ID，才可按评委跨样本检查打分倾向。这个例子是设计说明而非数据分析。
open_questions: 评委、样本与评审批次至少需要怎样的交叉/重复，才能区分主效应和交互？
有序评分 agreement 与 reliability 的正式定义和区别是什么？

memory_use.scope_check: 仅用于 UCI 文档所述葡萄酒评分定义；不推断数据中真实的评委分歧或可靠性。

learning_change: 初始 DNS 失败之后，控制端为原先研究者提出的两条 targeted queries 返回了来源；我实际阅读 K6a6a58450c07c23e 关于 generalizability theory/fully crossed person-by-rater-by-case 设计的段落，以及 K118ec9a5b92de666 关于单评委无法估计 inter-rater reliability 的限制段落。它们使我把数据要求从逐位评分进一步具体化为评委×样本链接和交叉结构，且提醒重复性需要重复观测。来源属于外科评估，不能直接指定葡萄酒有序评分的统计量。当前我仍不能正式区分 ordinal agreement 与 reliability、选取有序一致性系数或说明其假设；潜在感官属性的识别问题也未解决。
